name: Kanzaki Manami
source:
A female student attending a local school.

An excellent student who excels in both academics and sports, handling everything with ease.

She doesn’t have any particularly close friends and gives off a somewhat distant, hard-to-approach aura.

However, she takes the initiative to speak to [url=https://vndb.org/c84533]Manami[/url], the transfer student sitting next to her, and tries to help her adjust to school life.
